description: Encode a URL or text into a QR code image and return PNG and SVG. Nothing is stored, no account is required, and the image cannot be edited later. Use this when the user only needs a one-off QR and will not change the destination after printing. Do not use this for a short link, scan analytics, or a code they may want to edit (use create_fixed_link or create_dynamic_qr after sign-in). `content` is the payload, max 2048 characters. `type` is the payload kind (for example url or text). `fgColor` and `bgColor` are hex colors. `frameText` is optional label text drawn on the frame.

frameText.description: Optional label text drawn on the frame

type.description: Payload kind (for example url or text)

name: create_static_qr
title: Make QR code
